units.source_text: 源氏辞别玉鬘，就到东院去探望花散里。

en.t: Genji took leave of Tamakazura and went to the eastern residence to visit Hanachirusato.

units.source_text: 大概是今天早上骤寒，因而忽然想起了寒衣，

en.t: Perhaps because the morning had suddenly turned cold, she had abruptly thought of winter clothing,

units.source_text: 花散里身边聚集着许多长于裁缝的老年侍女。

en.t: and many elderly gentlewomen skilled at sewing had gathered around Hanachirusato.

units.source_text: 还有几个青年侍女，把丝绵绑在小衣柜似的东西上，正在拉扯。

en.t: Several younger attendants were also there, fastening silk floss to something like a small wardrobe and stretching it out.

units.source_text: 非常美丽的枯叶色绸缎，和颜色新颖的珍贵的绢，散置在一旁。

en.t: Exquisite dead-leaf-colored damask and precious silks in fresh new shades lay scattered nearby.

units.source_text: 源氏问道：“这是中将的衬袍么？

en.t: Genji asked, "Is this an underrobe for the captain?

units.source_text: 今年宫中不举办秋花宴。

en.t: There will be no autumn flower banquet at court this year.

units.source_text: 朔风如此猖獗，什么事情也办不成了。

en.t: With the north wind raging like this, nothing can be carried out.

units.source_text: 这个秋天真是大杀风景啊！”

en.t: This autumn has truly lost all its charm!"

units.source_text: 他不懂得她们在缝什么衣服，但觉各种织物色彩都很美丽，

en.t: He did not know what garments they were sewing, but he felt that all the fabrics were beautifully colored,

units.source_text: 想道：“此人对于染色一道，本领不亚于紫姬呢。”

en.t: and thought, "In the art of dyeing, this lady is no less accomplished than Lady Murasaki."

units.source_text: 她替源氏缝的官袍，是中国花绫的，

en.t: The court robe she had sewn for Genji was made of Chinese figured damask,

units.source_text: 用这时节摘取的竹叶兰的汁水淡淡地染成，色彩非常雅观。

en.t: lightly dyed with juice from bamboo-leaf orchids picked in this season, and its color was extremely elegant.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“给中将的衣服染成这色彩吧。

en.t: Genji said, "Dye the captain's robe in this color.

units.source_text: 少年人穿这种色彩的衣服，倒很好看呢。”

en.t: A young man would look very fine wearing a garment of this shade."

units.source_text: 谈了些这一类的话，就回去了。

en.t: After saying a few things of that sort, he went back.
